title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 135
text:
135. Intermediaries will, with the approval of the court:
• Advise on the selection of appropriate aids, eg a body map for a witness asked to
clarify intimate touching. The failure to ask a non-verbal witness to identify body parts
by reference to pictures was criticised in R v F.92
• Develop aids specifically tailored to the needs of the witness and the advocate’s
questions, eg development of a visual timeline to support questions about several
incidents over time.

91 The Advocate’s Gateway Toolkit 14: “Using communication aids in the criminal justice system”.

92 [2013] EWCA Crim 424.

136. Where helpful, witnesses should be allowed to write and draw to clarify answers.
